purpose: test whether the glial niche secretome SOURCE is attenuated in cognitively-resilient (high-pathology-cognition-preserved) brains; requires a cohort with niche glia + cognition + pathology
gating: Phase-0 eligibility exploration only; may run in parallel after the tag; NEVER reshapes CONSEQUENCE or TRAJECTORY
eligibility_criteria_all_required: astrocyte, microglia, endothelial, OPC/oligodendrocyte analysable per donor
pathology burden present (not only cognition/clinical diagnosis)
donor count and covariates adequate for the analysis

decision_rule.proceed_to_analysis: only if ALL eligibility criteria met
decision_rule.if_eligible: freeze a separate analysis plan (C3) before any real analysis
decision_rule.if_cortical: frame as cross-brain-region glial vulnerability association, NOT an SGZ-niche reproduction; avoid hippocampal-niche extrapolation
decision_rule.if_none_eligible: record 'no eligible cohort' as a formal result; no approximate adoption
decision_rule.no_design_feedback: findings from SOURCE never change CONSEQUENCE or TRAJECTORY primary design
